title: Reusability report: multi-sample omics network inference operates in distinct robustness regimes defined by prior knowledge and data availability
title_zh: 可重用性报告：多样本组学网络推断在由先验知识和数据可用性定义的不同鲁棒性阶段中运行
abstract: Abstract Knowledge-constrained network inference enables the reconstruction of regulatory programmes from high-dimensional biological data, yet the conditions under which shared and context-specific structures can be reliably identified remain poorly understood. Pablo Rodriguez-Mier et al. recently introduced CORNETO, a framework for multi-sample constrained inference. Here we reproduce, evaluate and extend CORNETO in terms of robustness, identifiability and bias–variance trade-offs. Using dynamic haematopoiesis and stable cortical datasets, we systematically assess four network reconstruction paradigms while preserving the original method-specific evaluation procedures and benchmark definitions. We show that multi-sample inference generally improves robustness and reproducibility, although gains in predictive performance depend on biological context and the completeness of the prior network. To enhance stability, we introduce bootstrap aggregation and selective re-expansion strategies that improve consensus robustness and recovery while preserving context-specific signals without modifying the underlying optimization scheme or sacrificing generality. Across datasets and methods, our results reveal distinct inference regimes governed by sample availability, prior knowledge and regularization. Together, these findings position network reconstruction as a regime-dependent learning problem and provide practical principles for robust multi-sample biological network inference.
abstract_zh: 摘要：受限网络推断通过高维生物数据重建调控程序，但在何种条件下能够可靠识别共享与上下文特异结构仍不清楚。Pablo Rodriguez-Mier 等人最近提出了 CORNETO，一个多样本受限推断框架。本文在鲁棒性、可识别性和偏差-方差权衡方面复现、评估并扩展了 CORNETO。利用动态造血和稳定皮层数据集，我们系统评估了四种网络重建范式，同时保持原方法特定的评估流程和基准定义。结果表明，多样本推断通常提升鲁棒性和可重复性，尽管预测性能的提升取决于生物学背景和先验网络的完整性。为增强稳定性，我们引入了自助聚合和选择性再扩展策略，提升共识鲁棒性和恢复率，同时保留上下文特异信号，而不改变基础优化方案或牺牲通用性。在不同数据集和方法中，我们的结果揭示了由样本可用性、先验知识和正则化决定的不同推断阶段。综上，这些发现将网络重建定位为一个受阶段影响的学习问题，并为稳健的多样本生物网络推断提供了实用原则。
